# Now 2.13.52
- The lyrics keep the elastic, wave-like line change introduced in the last version, but it now costs a fraction of what it did. The previous release computed the motion continuously while the lines moved, which was heavy enough to be worth doing differently; each line now carries its own tuned spring instead, matched against the original simulation so the movement looks the same.

# Now 2.13.51
- The lyrics are now driven by a real coupled spring simulation rather than a scheduled sequence. Each line is pulled toward the position of the line above it, so movement travels down the stack as a wave. Lines further from the one being sung move progressively more gently, which is what gives the motion its elasticity, and a line change arriving while the stack is still moving flows through it instead of restarting.

# Now 2.13.50
- Scrolling the lyrics now only works when the pointer is actually over them. The full screen view covers the whole display, so a stray two-finger movement anywhere else, over the artwork or the empty background, used to drag the lyrics and pop up the "Back to current" button. - Taking over now needs a deliberate swipe rather than a brush. A resting hand on a trackpad sends a trickle of tiny movements, which was enough to hand control over; the lyrics now wait for a real amount of travel, and a pause resets it rather than adding unrelated nudges together.
